mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, product_id, product_name, points_cost, quantity, total_points, price_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, shipping_address, status, confirmed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_exchange (order_no, user_id, product_id, product_name, points_cost, quantity, total_points, price_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, shipping_address, status, created_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{pointsCost}, #{quantity}, #{totalPoints}, #{priceAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{shippingAddress}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM point_exchange WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT FROM point_exchange WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM point_exchange WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
